title: Study Guide: Delegation Patterns
limitations: Generated from concept pages; not yet reviewed.

sections.heading: Prerequisites
sections.body: Before studying delegation patterns, ensure you understand the agent runtime (Module 02-03), tool contracts (Module 04), and the event system (AgentEventKind).

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Read the concept page: docs/course/concepts/delegation-patterns.md. Focus on the architecture diagram, the frontier comparison table, and the limitations section.

sections.heading: Code trace
sections.body: Open the source files listed in the concept page. Trace one complete flow from input to output. Note which data structures are used and why.

sections.heading: Run the tests
sections.body: Run the related tests with `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_delegation_patterns.py -v`. Read each test to understand what behavior is being verified.

sections.heading: Self-check
sections.body: Answer the 7 self-check questions from the concept page without looking at the answers. If you can't answer one, re-read the relevant section.

sections.heading: Practice exercise
sections.body: Modify one aspect of the implementation (e.g., add a new built-in hook, change a compaction threshold, add a delegation pattern). Run the tests to verify your change.
